# Mozart (02, engineer) — SPD-096

## Brief
Build the parked ticket status exactly as Osprey's design note specifies. The design is
settled; you implement it, you do not re-decide it. Where the note is wrong about a line
number or a fact, follow the code and say so in your Result — but if you think a *design*
choice is wrong, file a proposal and build it as specified anyway.

## The design, in one paragraph

`parked` becomes a fifth ticket status (`queued|active|parked|done|declined`) via migration
`0003_parked`, which rebuilds `tickets` with two new columns, `parked_reason` (required iff
parked) and `parked_until` (optional `YYYY-MM-DD`, parked only), both CHECK-bound. It is set
only by `ticket move <key> --status parked --reason "…" [--until YYYY-MM-DD]` and cleared by
a move to `queued|active|declined`; `parked -> parked` is a legal renewal; `parked -> done`
is not. "Waiting" is not a second status — it is `parked` with an `--until` date. `spud board`
sorts parked after queued; `spud board --brief` and the `SessionStart` injection omit parked
tickets except one trailing count line plus a full line for each whose `until` has arrived,
placed above the queued block; `spud board --parked` lists them with reason and date.

## Result
Built the parked ticket status of SPD-096 exactly as Osprey's design note specifies, steps 1 to 7 of section 5, tests before code at each step.

Code, all under `bin/spudlib/`: `state/schema.py` — `DDL_0003` rebuilding `tickets` with the fifth status and the two CHECK-bound columns, the `MIGRATIONS` entry (`SCHEMA_VERSION` 3), and `v_board`'s SELECT list and CASE. `state/ledgerdb.py` — foreign keys off before `BEGIN`, `PRAGMA foreign_key_check` inside the transaction raising `SpudError` so `write_txn` rolls back, foreign keys on in a `finally`. `core/kernel.py` — `TICKET_STATUSES`, six new `TICKET_TRANSITIONS` pairs including the `parked -> parked` renewal and no `parked -> done`, `TICKET_FM_KEYS` and the new `PARKED_FM_KEYS`. `commands/ticketcmds.py` — the `--reason`/`--until` contract checked before a row is read, the live-member refusal, the one UPDATE, the event body, the report entry's reason line, `format_ticket`, and `parked_tail` shared by all four. `state/ops.py`'s `insert_ticket` and `state/lookup.py`'s `ticket_dict` carry both columns. `cli/cliparser.py` — `date_arg`, `--until`, `board --parked`, and the help of section 3.4. `projects/sessions.py` — `board_line` plus the brief's new order, due-back lines and count line. `commands/views.py` — `--parked` with the until and reason columns. `projects/install.py` counts parked as open. `render/notefiles.py` emits the two keys only while parked. `imports/accept.py` refuses a hand edit of the three fields. `imports/noteimport.py` carries both through an import.

Tests: a new `tests/test_migrate_parked.py` (7 tests: the v2 refusal, the backup, every row and id kept with an empty `foreign_key_check`, the foreign keys still held, each CHECK refused at the database, the index and the append-only triggers, `v_board`'s order, and a fresh database applying all three migrations), plus cases in `test_tickets` (the state machine, `--until` validation, `--json`/show/events, the live-member refusal, board sorting, the brief's count and due-back lines, `--parked` and `--parked --brief`), `test_report_entries`, `test_render` (parked frontmatter, an untouched note byte for byte, the hand-edit refusals), `test_import` (a parked round trip and an export with no reason refused by the CHECK), `test_projects`, `test_sessions` (the per-project count) and `test_hooks` (the injection). The version assertions moved from 2 to 3 in `test_init`, `test_backup`, `test_migrate_projects` and `test_hooks`.

Two things the design note has wrong, both corrected in code and logged as I found them. First, `DDL_0002` needed `DROP VIEW v_board` and `v_fleet` too: `apply_migrations` runs the newest `VIEWS_AND_TRIGGERS` after every migration, so on a fresh database `v_board` names `parked_until` before `0003` adds it, and `0002`'s `ALTER TABLE events_new RENAME` re-parses every view and fails on it. The note's probe ran only the `0003` DDL, not the `0001`-`0002`-`0003` chain. Second, with the two keys in `TICKET_FM_KEYS`, `imports/noteimport.ticket_layout` stored an `fm_keys` layout for every unparked note that round-trips (`test_heading_round_trip` caught it); it now takes `parked` and builds the conditional default, exactly as `member_layout` does for `## Blocked`.

Verified. The whole suite: 916 tests, OK, 597 seconds. `find bin tests -name '*.pyc' -o -name __pycache__` prints nothing. `hook_timing.py 30` against main: PreToolUse(Bash) -0.01 ms, PreToolUse(Write) +0.00, SessionStart +0.13, Stop +0.33, board +0.15 — every hook case within 1 ms. `module_sizes.py`: 0 files at 1000 and over, 21 at 250 and over; `schema.py` 268 to 316 lines (the `DDL_0003` block, one body of SQL) and `sessions.py` 277 to 305, both as the note expects, neither refactored. A manual end-to-end in a scratch home, driven through `tests/helpers.py`'s `Home` because the Bash hook refuses a subagent the ledger-wide commands: park with a reason and a date, park with a reason alone, `board`, `board --brief` showing only the count line, `board --parked`, `board --parked --brief`, `ticket show`, the rendered frontmatter, a past date printing as due back above the queue, a renewal, an unpark that drops both keys, the queued note byte-identical throughout, and the day's report carrying each reason — every line matching section 3 of the note.

Left for Spud, as the brief says: sections 4.5, 6 and 7 — `Board.base`, `Home.md`, the ticket template, `CLAUDE.md`, SPD-082's brief, the migration of the real database, and the six BadTakes moves. No proposals; no open questions.

## Outcome
Accepted. Built all seven steps of Osprey's checklist and caught two things the design note had wrong, both of which only a chained run could find: DDL_0002 also needed its views dropped, because apply_migrations runs the newest VIEWS_AND_TRIGGERS after every migration and 0002's rename then re-parses a v_board that names a column 0003 has not added yet — Osprey's probe ran the 0003 DDL alone, not the chain, so this is exactly the gap a probe leaves. And noteimport.ticket_layout stored a redundant fm_keys layout for every unparked note once the two keys joined TICKET_FM_KEYS; taking 'parked' and building the conditional default matches what member_layout already does for Blocked.
